criteria.title: A template or score cannot choose the opinion.

observations.test: G06 qualified adverse and disclaimer paths retain actual separate opinion and section decisions with no copied source-wording adoption

criteria.title: Changed statements or conclusions cannot silently retain stale report approval.

observations.test: G06 returned wording retains prior content and exact review history while changed preparation invalidates old signatures and approval
observations.action: actual wording return, preparer correction/resubmission, independent exact review and renewed authorization
observations.observed: A returned preparation retains old wording and the reviewer reason. Self-approval is denied. Corrected wording keeps the actual opinion/section links and receives independent approval. Old authorization/signature cannot cover new bytes; new authorization retains earlier artifacts in immutable history.

observations.test: G06 changed originals and recipient capacity block current release while retaining prior authorized bytes

A changed actual contact scope blocks the pending recipient link and current release while the earlier issued hash remains in history.
